section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (no explicit study numbering) with 322 female university students recruited at a university in Greater London. It reports mean age (M = 24.72, SD = 5.90), mean BMI (M = 21.67, SD = 3.48), and ethnic composition (63.7% European Caucasian, 13.7% Asian, 13.7% African Caribbean, 9.0% other).
section_summary.evidence_source: Full participants paragraph: "The participants of this study were 322 female university students enrolled in a number of courses at a university in Greater London (age M = 24.72, SD = 5.90; BMI M = 21.67, SD = 3.48). The majority of participants were of European Caucasian descent (63.7%), while the remainder were of Asian descent (13.7%), African Caribbean descent (13.7%), or other ancestry (9.0%)."
